{{Quote|We are ''here'', Yaru. We are here and we are out of action. Out of the war. Out of everything. We are out of it!"<br />"''You're'' out of it.|Devore Korsin and his brother, Yaru|<ref name="precipice" />}}
'''Devore Korsin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Sith mineralogical corps]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The son of a veteran [[Eldrak Korsin|admiral]] in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]], Korsin started work with the Sith [[Mineral/Legends|mineralogical]] service after a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addiction derailed his naval career. During these [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]] who had escaped her [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] at the hands of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]], and together they had a son, [[Jariad Korsin|Jariad]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Korsin was assigned to a [[Lignan crystal|Lignan]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaegon III]], where he was to work under his half-brother, [[Yaru Korsin]]. Korsin was envious of his brother's position of authority and appealed to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] for Yaru's job, to no avail.

However, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]] deflected Korsin's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', off-course as it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] bound for [[Kirrek]]; the ''Omen'' crashed on an [[Kesh/Legends|uncharted planet]], although Korsin and most of the crew, including his wife and son, survived. Korsin soon became resigned to the fact that the crew would not be able to escape the planet after an examination of the ''Omen''{{'s}} wrecked remains and, under the influence of spice, he had a confrontation with his brother that descended into an all-out [[Duel near the Omen|lightsaber duel]]. Ultimately, Devore was defeated and dropped off a cliff by his brother, his body swept away by the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] below.

==Biography==
===An ill-fated mission===
{{Quote|I have sent for your brother, Devore, to inform him that you will be in charge. But remember that you are all subject to ''my'' law and whim.|Naga Sadow, in a message to Yaru Korsin|<ref name="pantheon" />}}
[[File:NagaSadow-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|180px|Naga Sadow, Dark Lord of the Sith]]
Devore Korsin, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] the son of an [[Eldrak Korsin|admiral]] in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]], an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who conceived Korsin with a [[Devore Korsin's mother|woman]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] he visited during his travels. Devore did not know the elder Korsin as a child. At some point he sought his [[Parent/Legends|father]] out, and the [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] embraced him without a second thought. Devore found his way into a [[Korsin family|family]] descended from a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house of the [[Tapani Empire]], skilled in commerce and industry. The Korsin family had come into the service of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], operating [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and factories; over [[Time/Legends|time]] their lineage became entwined with those of the Empire's [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], making the Korsins, including Devore, strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="precipice" /> 

Korsin discovered that he had an older half-brother, [[Yaru Korsin|Yaru]], who was a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] in the Sith navy. Korsin initially pursued a naval career himself, but his tenure was derailed after he developed an addiction to [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. He began work with the [[Sith mineralogical corps|Sith mineralogical service]], where [[Currency/Legends|money]] and power were more easily obtained searching for gems and Force-imbued [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. With his father's sponsorship, Korsin became proficient in the use of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons and scanning equipment. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], he learned to harness his inner Force potential, and became proficient with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Korsin eventually [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman<ref name="precipice" /> from [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]] named [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]], who had escaped the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]].<ref name="paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref> Together they had a son, [[Jariad Korsin|Jariad]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] launched an [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large, and Korsin accompanied [[Sith invasion fleet|Sadow's fleet]] as it left [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]].<ref name="precipice" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Korsin was assigned to the<ref name="precipice" /> [[Sith dreadnaught]]<ref name="crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> ''[[Omen]]'', on a mission to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] valuable [[Lignan crystal]]s from [[Phaegon III]] and later deliver them to the Sith forces on [[Kirrek]]. The operation was to be [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by Yaru Korsin, by then a respected [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Sith navy. Wanting to lead the mission himself and envious of his brother's power, Devore appealed to Sadow himself on the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] station near the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], only to be denied&mdash;angered by his rejection, Korsin said something to Sadow that put doubt about his loyalty and the safety of the ''Omen''{{'s}} cargo into the Dark Lord's mind. With the expedition proceeding as scheduled, Korsin's wife, Seelah, accompanied him as part of his mining crew, taking their infant son along with them. However, before they left, the ''Omen'' and a sister ship, the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attacked]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Before the ''Omen'' was able to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]],<ref name="precipice" /> one of the Jedi, [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Drev Hassin]], [[Death/Legends|suicidally]] crashed his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the ''Harbinger''.<ref name="crosscurrent" />

===Crash of the ''Omen''===
{{Quote|Enough. Let me at those controls!''"<br />"''They're as dead for you as they are for me!''"<br />"''We'll see about that!|Devore and Yaru Korsin, as the former attempts to take control of the ''Omen''|<ref name="precipice" />}}
[[File:Yaru_Korsin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Yaru Korsin, Devore Korsin's stepbrother.]]
As a result of the collision, the ''Harbinger'' hit the ''Omen'' as it jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], nudging it off course. As the ''Omen'' traveled away from the site of the skirmish, the ship was severely damaged by a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]], which pulled the ''Omen'' back into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. Korsin, realizing the danger of the situation, told Seelah to take Jariad with her to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], while he made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Even though the ''Omen'' was not safe by any means, Korsin immediately turned the blame on the ship's veteran [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], [[Boyle Marcom]]. Korsin was interrupted by his brother before he could do Marcom any harm, and the ''Omen'' soon entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Kesh/Legends|nearby planet]]. Although the ship was crashing, Korsin and the others were relieved to discover that the planet had [[Oxygen/Legends|breathable air]]. Sensing his brother's inner doubt, Korsin forcibly tried to seize control of the ship, only to end the struggle when Seelah arrived on the bridge with Jariad, both having survived the ordeal. As Korsin argued with his wife and brother, they suddenly sighted land.<ref name="precipice" />

Despite Yaru's best efforts to bring the ''Omen'' down gracefully, the Sith [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] crashed violently onto a [[Takara Mountains|plateau]]. Fortunately for Korsin, he and his family survived the crash and the hazardous trip away down the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], making camp in the valley below. Korsin's rage at Marcom did not diminish, and he confronted the veteran [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with several of his miners. After blaming Marcom for the ship's crash, Korsin [[Shiak|gutted]] him with his lightsaber in front of Seelah and Jariad. Yaru soon came upon the scene, furious at his brother for killing their [[Navigator/Legends|navigation officer]], but Devore dismissed Yaru's concerns.<ref name="precipice" />

===Duel and death===
{{Quote|It's over, Yaru. We should have done this before. It's been decided. ''I'm'' Commander Korsin.|Devore Korsin, to Yaru Korsin, before their duel|<ref name="precipice" />}}
[[File:Duel_near_Omen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The duel between Yaru and Devore Korsin, as witnessed by Adari Vaal]]
Devore returned to the wreckage of the ''Omen'', intent on finding something that they could use to facilitate an escape from the planet. His search was unsuccessful, and a defeated Korsin took a dose of [[Red Rage]] spice and rested in the commander's chair. Yaru eventually entered the ship as well, intending to test the functionality of the ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]]&mdash;Devore had already done so, finding its circuitry to be completely fried. Although Yaru was hopeful to find a way back to civilization, Devore did not share his optimism and suggested that they stay where they were. The debate turned into a heated argument, and, after Yaru broached the subject of Devore's meeting with Sadow, Devore ignited his lightsaber and attacked his brother with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force whirlwind]]. Devore found himself flung outside the remains of the ''Omen'', and a full-fledged [[Duel near the Omen|lightsaber duel]] ensued.<ref name="precipice" />

Devore gained the upper hand through the manic power granted to him by the influence of Red Rage, but Yaru turned the tables by using the Force to use the ''Omen'' itself as a weapon, smashing Devore with a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] tube door and partially burying Devore under a pile of rocks on the plateau's precipice. Wounded, Devore pleaded to his brother for mercy&mdash;instead, Yaru dropped him over the edge of the cliff, killing him.<ref name="precipice" /> Korsin landed on the rocks below, where he was found by [[Adari Vaal]], a member of the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had by chance witnessed the duel. Ultimately, Korsin's body was swept away by a nearby [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref>

After Devore Korsin's death, the surviving crew of the ''Omen'' escaped their predicament by impersonating the [[Skyborn|gods]] of the planet's Keshiri natives.<ref name="skyborn" /> Stranded on the world, which they discovered was called Kesh, the crew formed a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith order]] that survived for more than five thousand years.<ref name="omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> Seelah married Yaru after Devore's death and had a daughter with him, [[Nida Korsin|Nida]]. However, Seelah still loved Devore<ref name="paragon" /> and plotted to avenge his death. Although the nature of Devore's death was kept a secret, Seelah learned of Yaru's complicity by [[Telepathy/Legends|reading the thoughts]] of Adari Vaal. Jariad was also raised to hate Yaru and revere his father, and, in [[4975 BBY]], Jariad and Seelah led an [[Duel near the Kesh Sith Temple|attack]] on Yaru near the [[Kesh Sith Temple]] to wreak vengeance and take control of the Sith tribe. Although they succeeded in killing Yaru, Seelah lost the use of her [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and Jariad was killed by Nida, who was fighting on her father's side.<ref name="savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh, what's the use talking to&hellip;|Boyle Marcom, referring to Devore Korsin|<ref name="precipice" />}}
Immature and reckless, Devore Korsin held an undying ambition.<ref name="paragon" /> Always apt to cut corners,<ref name="savior" /> especially to pursue power and riches, Korsin was quick to assign blame, even in the most dire of circumstances. Korsin had a contentious relationship with his half-brother, Yaru&mdash;while Yaru resented Devore's various character flaws, Devore was envious of Yaru's position of authority on their Lignan mining mission, and was willing to do whatever it took to seize control. Korsin had a considerably closer relationship with his wife, Seelah, although he could be dismissive of her and he sometimes found himself annoyed by Seelah.<ref name="precipice" />

Korsin was possessed of a near-constant anger and held no qualms about lashing out at the people whom he felt had wronged him or were standing in his way. These fits of anger were enhanced by his addiction to spice. Korsin held a great respect for the toughness of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors who accompanied the mission, finding it hard to believe when they started to die off following the ''Omen''{{'s}} crash on Kesh. Korsin was one of the first to resign himself to the fact that the ''Omen''{{'s}} crew would not be able to escape Kesh. He possessed [[Color/Legends|pale]] skin and dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="precipice" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|That was our navigator, Devore! What if the star charts don't work?''"<br />"''I can find our way back.|Yaru and Devore Korsin, after the latter killed their navigator, Boyle Marcom|<ref name="precipice" />}}
As strong as any of the Sith in his family, Devore Korsin found his natural abilities enhanced by the manic rage provided by spice, especially the Red Rage variant that he favored. Korsin was skilled in the use of a lightsaber and, through his father's sponsorship and his work in the Sith [[Mineral/Legends|mineralogical]] service, that of plasma weapons and scanning equipment as well. Korsin also was trained in the use of the Force, able to use techniques such as Force whirlwind. Korsin believed that he could take on the job of a navigator if star charts did not work.<ref name="precipice" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Then we will cut the ship down deck by deck and fabricate the parts we need!''"<br />"''With what? Our lightsabers? We're done!|Yaru and Devore Korsin argue about if the ''Omen'' can be repaired|<ref name="precipice" />}}
In the Sith mineralogical corps, Korsin utilized plasma weapons and scanning equipment. On the ''Omen'', Korsin wore a golden uniform, [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and carried spice in vials. He also fought using a lightsaber with a red blade.<ref name="precipice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Devore Korsin first appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', the first installment in the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series.<ref name="precipice" />
